title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller based in St Helen's, you'll play a key role in managing customer accounts and ensuring timely payments. This is a 12 week contract to help support.

Client Details

Our client is an established business in St Helen's, they are looking for an experienced Credit Controller for 12 weeks to help support out with key accounts and high-volume backlog.

Description

The Credit Controller duties include:
- Manage and monitor customer accounts to ensure timely payments.
- Contact customers to follow up on overdue invoices and resolve payment delays.
- Reconcile accounts and investigate discrepancies.
- Prepare and maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Work closely with internal teams to address and resolve queries related to accounts.
- Provide regular updates on outstanding debts and escalate issues where necessary.
- Contribute to improving processes to enhance efficiency in credit control.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Previous experience in a credit control or similar accounting role.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Good communication skills for liaising with customers and internal teams.
- The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
- Knowledge of accounting systems and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Job Offer

The benefits include:
- An hourly rate of 32-33k, weekly pay via Michael Page (including holidays)
- Full-time office
- Parking

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Scheduling Administrator
description:
Prestige Skills are currently seeking an organised and detail-orientated scheduler of work and jobs to join our dynamic team.

This role is crucial in ensuring the smooth operation of our services by effectively scheduling tasks, managing resources, and providing comprehensive support to our team and clients.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate and schedule tasks, assignments, and job orders, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and adherence to timelines.
- Maintain and update various databases and systems, including entering data, details, photographs and essential information accurately and promptly.
- Deliver outstanding customer service by addressing client queries and concerns through phone and email communications with professionalism and empathy.
- Ensure the internal database is up-to-date with incoming information and documents, utilising Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) proficiently.
- Manage communications with on-site engineers, monitoring their progress and addressing any issues that arise, ensuring smooth execution of tasks.
- Liaise with clients to gather all necessary job information, ensuring clear and effective communication between all parties.
- Handle stock ordering and monitoring, including comparing wholesaler prices, to support operational needs.
- Maintain an up-to-date work schedule and assist in document preparation and filing as needed.
- Support colleagues and contribute to team efforts by accomplishing related tasks as required.

Requirements:
- Proven experience in office administration or a similar role, with at least 1 year preferred.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- Ability to work unsupervised to tight deadlines
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience with CRM systems.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a proactive and problem-solving attitude.
- No remote working option is available; the candidate must be able to work on-site.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Schedule:
- 8am to 5pm
- 30 mins unpaid lunch break
- Monday to Friday

Experience:
- Office Administration: 1 year (required)

title: Business Support Admin
description:
Business Support Admin (Multi-Team Support)

Liverpool/Knowsley
Full Time

We're looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and enjoys variety in their role. As a Work Coordinator supporting multiple teams across our Heating & Compliance department, you'll play a vital role in ensuring work is planned, scheduled and delivered efficiently across a range of services.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is adaptable, highly organised and confident building relationships with a variety of stakeholders. No two days will be the same as you provide coordination support wherever it's needed most, helping teams maintain excellent service delivery for our customers and clients.

We Can Offer You:
- Work-Life Balance: 23 days annual leave + bank holidays, plus flexibility with overtime
- Health & Wellbeing: 24/7 GP access, mental health support, fitness programmes, and more
- Training & Growth: Ongoing professional development to keep you at the top of your game

Your Role as Our Business Support Administrator
- Coordinate and schedule works across multiple Heating & Compliance teams, ensuring programmes are delivered effectively.
- Prioritise and schedule appointments, repairs, servicing, compliance activities and reinstatement works as required.
- Reschedule jobs that fall out of programme and proactively manage changing priorities.
- Support operational teams during periods of increased demand, absence, annual leave or changing business needs.
- Help us manage contract requirements across a diverse range of workstreams and clients.
- Handle customer and contractor calls, scheduling works and resolving queries efficiently.
- Validate jobs to ensure all relevant information and documentation is available prior to allocation.
- Build and maintain positive customer, client and stakeholder relationships.
- Ensure all regulatory and compliance information is accurately updated and logged in real time.
- Monitor work queues and provide updates to customers, engineers, supervisors and managers.
- Provide an efficient and flexible response to operational issues to maintain service delivery standards and contract performance targets.
- Work collaboratively across teams, adapting quickly to different processes, priorities and workloads.

What We Need From You
- Good level of education.
- Previous experience in scheduling, work coordination, planning or call handling roles.
- Ability to operate computerised database systems and scheduling software.
- Good knowledge of office systems and administrative processes.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to adapt to changing business needs.
- A flexible and proactive approach, with confidence supporting different teams and workstreams.

Why Join Us?

This role offers a unique opportunity to develop a broad understanding of our Heating & Compliance operation while working alongside a range of experienced teams. You'll gain exposure to different services, build a diverse skillset, and become a key part of ensuring we continue to deliver outstanding service to our customers.

If you're adaptable, organised and enjoy working in a varied role where every day brings a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Given the nature of this position, you will need to undergo a Basic Disclosure and Barring Service Check (DBS) at offer stage. Applicants with criminal convictions will be assessed individually, and we assure you that we do not discriminate based on an applicant's criminal record or the details of any disclosed offenses. Additionally, certain roles may be subject to additional pre-employment checks.

To learn more about the checks included in this process, please click on the following link: National Security Vetting

title: Assistant Document Controller
description:
Full-Time Office-Based Renewables

Join Liberty and help the communities we serve!

We re looking for a Renewables Assistant Document Controller to join our Energy Transition team. This is a key support role, helping ensure our renewable projects run smoothly through accurate administration, document control and compliance support.

We Can Offer You:
- Stability & Security: Full-time, permanent role within a growing renewables team
- Work-Life Balance: 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Supportive Environment: Work closely with experienced operational, compliance and admin colleagues
- Training & Development: Exposure to renewable works, compliance frameworks and internal systems
- Purpose-Driven Work: Play a vital behind-the-scenes role supporting the energy transition

Your Role as Our Renewables Assistant Document Controller:
- Provide administrative and document control support across renewable energy projects
- Upload, manage and maintain documentation within SharePoint and internal systems
- Ensure project documents are accurate, complete and audit-ready
- Support lodgements, audits and compliance checks by coordinating required paperwork
- Record data accurately to support reporting and project visibility
- Answer email queries from operational teams and clients
- Work closely with operational, compliance and field teams to ensure smooth project delivery
- Maintain accurate records across multiple projects at the same time
- Carry out general office administration, including scanning, filing and photocopying
- Identify missing or incorrect information and take action to resolve issues quickly

What We Need from You:
- Strong administrative experience with excellent attention to detail
- Confidence using multiple systems and screens simultaneously
- Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume, task-driven environment
- Ability to manage competing priorities while meeting deadlines
- Clear and professional communication skills
- A proactive, organised and reliable approach to work
- Ability to follow defined processes while remaining adaptable
- Basic awareness of renewable works or compliance frameworks (desirable)
- Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a multi?disciplinary team

Why Liberty?

At Liberty, we re people focused, accountable and driven to make places safe, smart and better for all. You ll be joining a supportive team where accuracy, collaboration and professionalism make a real impact on the success of our renewable energy projects.

Apply Today!

Click Apply to join Liberty as a Renewables Assistant Document Controller.
We look forward to hearing from you.
